title: Power Rankings: Three Texas teams in top four
heading: 2006-07 Power Rankings: Week 11
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: As if a 31-4 record since that 0-4 start isn't gaudy enough, check this out: Dirk is shooting .525 and averaging 30.8 ppg since switching back to the leather ball.
